notes: Authored for GeoQuiz. Every flag in the app is drawn at 4:3 from flag-icons, so differences in official proportions are not visible; 'in_app' rates what a player can actually see: clear (an emblem, star or layout differs), subtle (shade or band width only), near_identical (practically the same picture in the app).

sets.explanation: All four are blue, yellow and red vertical stripes. Andorra and Moldova carry a coat of arms in the yellow stripe; Chad and Romania are plain and differ only in the blue, which is darker on Chad's flag.

cues.TCD: Plain stripes with a deep, navy-like blue.
cues.ROU: Plain stripes with a brighter cobalt blue.
cues.AND: Coat of arms in the centre, on a yellow stripe slightly wider than the others.
cues.MDA: Coat of arms with an eagle holding a cross, on stripes of equal width.

sets.explanation: Indonesia and Monaco both fly red over white in two equal halves; officially only their proportions differ, so at the same size they look the same.

cues.IDN: Red over white, officially a longer 2:3 rectangle.
cues.MCO: Red over white, officially a squarer 4:5 rectangle.

sets.explanation: Two plain halves in the same colours, in opposite order: Indonesia is red over white, Poland white over red.
The same three colours in mirror order. Ireland starts with green at the flagpole; Côte d'Ivoire starts with orange.

cues.IRL: Green next to the flagpole, orange on the outer edge.
cues.CIV: Orange next to the flagpole, green on the outer edge.

sets.explanation: Both are green, white and red vertical stripes. Mexico adds its emblem of an eagle on a cactus in the centre; Italy's white stripe is empty.

cues.MEX: Eagle and cactus emblem on the white stripe, with a darker green.

sets.explanation: Both are dark blue with the Union Jack in the corner and the Southern Cross. Australia's stars are white and include a large seven-pointed star under the Union Jack; New Zealand has four red stars edged in white.

cues.AUS: Six white stars, including a large one beneath the Union Jack.
cues.NZL: Four red stars with white outlines, and no star under the Union Jack.

sets.explanation: Both are red, white and blue horizontal stripes. The difference is the blue: a dark blue for the Netherlands and a light sky blue for Luxembourg.
West African tricolours in green, yellow and red. Senegal puts a green star in the centre and Mali is plain; Guinea uses the same colours in reverse, with red at the flagpole.

cues.SEN: Green star on the yellow centre stripe.
cues.MLI: Plain stripes, green at the flagpole.
cues.GIN: Plain stripes, red at the flagpole.

sets.explanation: Three white, blue and red horizontal stripes. Russia's are plain. Slovakia has a large red shield with a white double cross over blue hills; Slovenia has a smaller blue shield showing a white mountain and three gold stars, placed higher up near the corner.

cues.SVN: Small blue shield with a white mountain peak and gold stars, high in the corner.
cues.SVK: Large red shield with a white double cross, spanning all three stripes.

sets.explanation: Yellow, blue and red horizontal stripes. Colombia and Ecuador give yellow the top half; Ecuador adds a coat of arms with a condor. Venezuela's stripes are equal, with an arc of white stars in the blue.

cues.COL: Yellow fills the top half; no emblem.
cues.ECU: Yellow fills the top half, with a coat of arms in the centre.
cues.VEN: Three equal stripes with an arc of eight white stars.

sets.explanation: Each has a cross outlined in white, with the colours swapped: Norway is a blue cross on red, Iceland a red cross on blue.
Both are red with a cross set towards the flagpole. Denmark's cross is plain white; Norway's white cross has a blue cross inside it.
Both have a white band at the flagpole joined by a zigzag edge. Qatar is maroon with nine points; Bahrain is a brighter red with five.
Blue over red in two halves. Haiti places its coat of arms on a white panel in the centre; Liechtenstein has a gold crown in the top corner.

cues.HTI: Coat of arms on a white rectangle in the centre.
cues.LIE: Gold crown near the flagpole on the blue half.

sets.explanation: Red, white and black horizontal stripes; the emblem on the white stripe tells them apart. Yemen has none, Egypt a gold eagle and Iraq a phrase in green Arabic script.
Black, white and green stripes with a red triangle at the flagpole. Jordan's triangle holds a small white seven-pointed star; Palestine's is empty.

cues.JOR: White star inside the red triangle.
cues.PSE: No star in the red triangle.

sets.explanation: Central American flags in blue and white. Guatemala's stripes are vertical. Honduras has five blue stars in the centre. Nicaragua and El Salvador both show a triangle emblem: Nicaragua's sits in a ring of lettering, while El Salvador's is framed by a laurel wreath and flags.

cues.HND: Five blue stars in the centre.
cues.NIC: Triangle emblem inside a circle of lettering.
cues.SLV: Triangle emblem framed by a green wreath and flags.
cues.GTM: Vertical stripes, with an emblem showing a bird and crossed rifles.

sets.explanation: Red, white, red. Austria uses a bright red and three equal stripes; Latvia uses a dark carmine and a narrower white stripe.
Similar colours, different direction. Belgium's stripes are vertical in black, yellow and red; Germany's are horizontal in black, red and gold.

cues.BEL: Vertical stripes, yellow in the middle.
cues.DEU: Horizontal stripes, red in the middle.

sets.explanation: Horizontal stripes in red, yellow and green. Bolivia has red on top, and Ghana does too but adds a black star in the centre. Lithuania starts with yellow and ends with red.

cues.BOL: Red, yellow, green from the top.
cues.GHA: Red, gold, green with a black star.
cues.LTU: Yellow, green, red from the top.

sets.explanation: The same three colours in a different order. Bulgaria runs white, green, red from the top; Hungary runs red, white, green.
Both show a crescent and star on red. Turkey's are white and set towards the flagpole; Tunisia's are red, inside a white disc in the centre.

cues.TUR: White crescent and star directly on the red.
cues.TUN: Red crescent and star inside a white circle.

sets.explanation: Gold stars on red. Vietnam has one large star in the centre; China has one large star and four small ones in the top corner.

cues.CHN: Five stars grouped in the top corner.
cues.VNM: A single large star in the centre.

sets.explanation: Red and white stripes with a blue corner. The United States has 50 stars. Liberia has a single white star. Malaysia has a yellow crescent and a yellow star with 14 points.

cues.USA: Many small white stars in the corner.
cues.LBR: One large white star in the corner.
cues.MYS: Yellow crescent and star in the corner.
